function internal_bump_row_counts(p_tabl.name: internal_bump_row_counts
function internal_bump_row_counts(p_tabl.create:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION koldstore.internal_bump_row_counts(p_table_oid oid, p_hot_delta bigint, p_mirror_delta bigint)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'koldstore'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- Used by commit-time counter flush and maintenance paths. DML capture triggers should call
  -- koldstore.internal_record_row_count_delta instead (in-memory, no per-row manifest IO).
  -- After a successful flush (`in_sync`), subsequent DML dirties the catalog sync_state to
  -- `pending_write` so operators and flush eligibility see hot changes.
  PERFORM koldstore.internal_ensure_manifest_row(p_table_oid);
  UPDATE koldstore.manifest
  SET
    hot_row_count = GREATEST(0, hot_row_count + p_hot_delta),
    mirror_row_count = GREATEST(0, mirror_row_count + p_mirror_delta),
    sync_state = CASE
      WHEN sync_state = 'in_sync' THEN 'pending_write'
      ELSE sync_state
    END,
    updated_at = now()
  WHERE table_oid = p_table_oid
    AND scope_key = '';
END;
$function$

function internal_apply_flush_row_counts.add: koldstore.internal_apply_flush_row_counts(p_table_oid oid, p_mirror_pruned bigint, p_hot_pruned bigint, p_cold_rows_added bigint)
function internal_apply_flush_row_counts.name: internal_apply_flush_row_counts
function internal_apply_flush_row_counts.create:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION koldstore.internal_apply_flush_row_counts(p_table_oid oid, p_mirror_pruned bigint, p_hot_pruned bigint, p_cold_rows_added bigint)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'koldstore'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  PERFORM koldstore.internal_ensure_manifest_row(p_table_oid);
  UPDATE koldstore.manifest
  SET
    mirror_row_count = GREATEST(0, mirror_row_count - p_mirror_pruned),
    hot_row_count = GREATEST(0, hot_row_count - p_hot_pruned),
    cold_row_count = GREATEST(0, cold_row_count + p_cold_rows_added),
    updated_at = now()
  WHERE table_oid = p_table_oid
    AND scope_key = '';
END;
$function$
